s2.explanation: The producer uses bearer tokens while both consumers expect cookies.
s2.contractText: Use an HttpOnly session cookie. Login sets the cookie; browser requests send credentials; protected routes resolve the same cookie to the current user.

aligned.explanation: All three plans explicitly use the same session cookie.

revised.explanation: SIMULATION: a revised proposal after the first rejection.
revised.contractText: Use a signed HttpOnly session cookie with SameSite=Lax. Login sets it and protected routes resolve it to the current user.
